messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['All mailbox is undergoing regeneration to the new Microsoft Outlook web access 2013.', 'For security purpose, you are to confirm your account information.', 'Please click on the UPGRADE<http://www.cwebmail3.hol.es/inf/><https://webmail.bradford.nhs.uk/owa/redir.aspx?C=nOYiGVS2IEysV7zJnQMpE6-AV--RS9QIMhcyqjHi_wm_prhQClq1oCF6eUbT5LHsa2RCGhZJ7nk.&URL=http%3a%2f%2fxprs.imcreator.com%2ffree%2f36.mm616%2fmicrosoft-outlook-web> and sign in to the admin upgrade page for maintenance and update of your mailbox.', 'This is the final concluding mention to inform you as of 30 - Aug - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iCloud ID information.', 'All Staff & Employee Your Account was recently signed in by Unknown IP address: 103.740.110.128, kindly GATEWAY<https://mybank.ga/securemail/> to log out of other Unknown IP and verify your e-mail account or your e-mail will be automatically disable for sending more messages.', 'This service creates more space and easy access to email.', 'AOL Customer Department', 'Your mailbox is almost full.', 'If you do not update your Microsoft Office 365 account within 24 hours your account will be deactivated and deleted from our server, and you will no longer have access to many of the features for improved Conversations, contacts and attachments.', 'You should be able to use your usual address to access your mailbox within an hour.', "Your email service won't be affected and you'll keep all your old contacts, folders and messages.", 'Your Webmail Account was violated!', 'Current Mail Users Should Please Log On To IT-WEBSITE To Validate Your E-mail Address And Password, Or Your E-mail Address Will Be Deactivated.', 'Your iTunes account has been frozen because we are unable to validate your account information.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
